(1) इन जनयमों को भारतीय प्र िासजनक सेवा (वेतन) पांचवां संिोधन जनयमावली, 2026 कहा जाएगा। (2) ये जनयम राजपत्र में उनके प्र कािन की तारीख से प्र वृत्त होंगे। 2. भारतीय प्र िासजनक सेवा (वेतन) जनयमावली, (अक 10.06.2022 40. 244 (अक 01.04.2026 MINISTRY OF PERSONNEL, PUBLIC GRIEVANCES AND PENSIONS (Department of Personnel and Training) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 2nd April 2026 G.S.R. 250(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the All India Services Act, 1951 (61 of 1951), the Central Government, in consultation with the Government of Himachal Pradesh hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Indian Administrative Service (Pay) Rules, 2016, namely:─ 1. (1) These rules may be called the Indian Administrative Service (Pay) Fifth Amendment Rules, 2026. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the official Gazette. 2. In the Indian Administrative Service (Pay) Rules, 2016, in Schedule II, – (a) in Part A relating to Posts carrying pay above the Senior Scale of pay of the Indian Administrative Service under the State Governments, in the table, for the entry ―Himachal Pradesh‖ occurring in the first column and corresponding entries in the second column, the following shall be substituted namely: ─ “Himachal Pradesh Chief Secretary Level 17 in the pay matrix Additional Chief Secretary Level 17 in the pay matrix Principal Secretary Level 15 in the pay matrix Financial Commissioner (Appeals) Level 15 in the pay matrix Finance Commissioner cum-Principal Secretary (Revenue) Level 15 in the pay matrix Principal Resident Commissioner, New Delhi Level 15 in the pay matrix Divisional Commissioners Level 14 in the pay matrix Secretary to Government Level 14 in the pay matrix Secretary (Lokayukta) Level 14 in the pay matrix -- 4 of 6 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(i)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 5 Chief Electoral Officer-cum-Secretary (Election) Level 14 in the pay matrix Director of Industries Level 14 in the pay matrix State Excise & Taxation Commissioner Level 14 in the pay matrix Registrar, Co-operative Societies Level 14 in the pay matrix Director of Tourism & Civil Aviation Level 14 in the pay matrix Director of Vigilance Level 14 in the pay matrix Secretary to Governor, HP Level 14 in the pay matrix‖ (b) in Part B relating to Posts carrying pay in the Senior Scale of the Indian Administrative Service under the State Governments including posts carrying Special Allowance in addition to pay, in the table for the entries occurring under Himachal Pradesh the following shall be substituted, – ―Special Secretary/Additional Secretary/ Joint Secretary to the Government Secretary, Public Service Commission Director, Food, Civil Supplies & CA Director Rural Development & PR Labour Commissioner-cum-Director Employment & Trg.
